answer:
I added a page to your Reading log note. I didn't open it in the app, so I haven't seen how it looks. The table is unchanged.

The page has:
- **Cover-style cards:** each book gets a colored cover with its initial, then the title, author, finish date and star rating. Newest finished books come first.
- **Stats:** total books, books finished this year, and your average rating.
- **Books per month:** a bar chart for the last six months, with the count above each bar.
- **Log a book form:** a form at the bottom that adds a new row to your table.
- **Want to read:** this shows only if the note has a checklist. I didn't check whether yours does.

The cover initials are white text on a colored background. The app flagged it as having no dark-mode variant. I left it because white on these mid-tone colors should read fine in both light and dark.
